_comment: G25 ratchet (STANDARDS TEST-12): golden-failure artefacts committed before the gate existed. The list may only shrink and never exceed _test12Ceiling (0) in test/repository_hygiene_test.dart. A listed path that is no longer tracked fails the test (its message prints the smaller list to commit, and lower the ceiling with it). Preferred end state: git rm --cached these files, add failures/ to .gitignore, empty this list and set the ceiling to 0 in the same commit.
